zh-CN.name: 视差叙事
zh-CN.description: 随滚动让前景与背景以不同幅度移动，以空间层次辅助内容叙事。它不应改变正常滚动的控制权，内容顺序与静态版本必须仍可理解。
use_when: 长页内容具有适合层次表达的叙事段落。
可提供完整静态阅读方案。
avoid_when: 不要劫持滚动或改变浏览器正常导航习惯。
对运动敏感的用户需要关闭非必要位移。
zh-CN.prompt_template: 保持浏览器原生滚动，只在装饰层使用适度前后景位移；正文与主操作保持稳定；限制层数与运动范围，提供静态或减少动态效果版本，所有内容按正常顺序可访问。

en.name: Parallax Storytelling
en.description: Using different scroll-relative movement for foreground and background to support a narrative through depth. It should not take control of scrolling; the content order and static version must remain understandable.
use_when: A long page has narrative sections that benefit from depth cues.
A complete static reading alternative is available.
avoid_when: Avoid scroll hijacking and changes to normal browser navigation.
Motion-sensitive users need a way to disable nonessential movement.
en.prompt_template: Keep native browser scrolling and use restrained foreground-background movement only in decorative layers. Keep copy and primary actions stable, limit layers and motion range, provide static or reduced-motion alternatives, and preserve normal access to all content.
